records.issue_text: [BUG] In create(), registerIDPLoginInvalidation evaluates getLoginPredicate() on the incoming model, whose OrganizationId is set only after the organization provider links it via OrganizationProvider.addIdentityProvider / the org update path that bypasses this provider's update() (the org link mutates the IDP through the organization API), so no invalidation of the login caches occurs when an existing IDP is linked to or unlinked from an organization. Linking/unlinking an IDP to an organization through the organization management API leaves stale getForLogin caches: FetchMode.ORG_ONLY/ALL queries keep returning (or omitting) the IDP until some unrelated invalidation, so organization login pages show stale broker lists; the test only passes because step 4 mutates BROKER_PUBLIC config (which does invalidate) immediately before addIdentityProvider.

records.issue_text: [ADVISORY] The new predicate link dereferences idp.getConfig() without a null check, so any IdentityProviderModel with a null config map throws NullPointerException when getForLogin is invoked. The login predicate is applied to every IdentityProviderModel returned from storage on every getForLogin call; an IDP persisted without a config map (or a storage provider returning a model with null config) turns the realm's login page into a 500 error, a denial of the entire login flow for that realm. The legacy filters never dereferenced config unconditionally here, so this is newly introduced on this line.
